ConfigurableProduct:15217.meta_title: Clothing Labels | Clothes Stickers | Stick On Clothing Labels
ConfigurableProduct:15217.meta_description: Buy Wrap & Stick Clothing Labels made to order for you in Australia. Label clothes the fast & easy way with our durable clothes stickers!
ConfigurableProduct:15217.faq:
How can I only have a surname printed on the labels?

Simply enter the Surname into Line 1. 'First Name' and leave Line 2. 'Last Name' blank.

Can I choose more than one name?

Sorry this isn't available. However you can select a smaller number of labels, then personalise a second or third kit with different names.

What fabrics can these Labels be used on?

These labels work best on clothing care tags that have a nylon or polyester base. They can also be applied to brand or size labels that have a loop to thread these labels through. They’re perfect for school uniforms, hats, and underwear. No iron needed!

How do I apply these Labels?

Applying these wrap & stick clothing labels is a breeze. They apply easily to the care label inside most clothing items. Simply sit the label flat on the care label & fold the two outer sides behind, sticking them firmly on top of each other... kind of like the wrap & stick clothing label is giving your care label a bear hug. See our image gallery for the different ways you can apply these labels to all of your clothing items.

Can these Labels be used in my washing machine and tumble dryer?

Yes, once they've been applied correctly, they can be put through washing machines and tumble dryers without peeling off, even industrial style machines that are used in boarding schools and nursing homes.

How long will these labels last?

These wrap & stick clothing labels are semi-permanent and applied correctly, they will last for ages! If you're looking for a more permanent cotton clothing label, you'll love our iron on labels that come in a variety of coordinated designs & match beautifully with our personalised school & daycare supplies.

What materials are the Stick & Wrap Clothing Labels made from?

Our wrap & stick clothing labels are produced on a high quality vinyl. It’s waterproof & when the wrap & stick label is folded over itself around your care tag, it stays stuck. The adhesive on the back of these tags is designed to stay stuck & last in the washer & dryer.

Got an extra large care tag?

You can either fold the care tag in half and wrap the label around like normal. Or you can use 2 of the Wrap & Stick labels, one on the back of the other so that there’s a good amount of vinyl adhering the 2 labels together. Alternatively, we now have a Large Wrap & Stick Clothing Label option for extra large care tags.

Can I choose a different font for the extra details on the labels?

Unfortunately, the font for the extra details is not able to be personalised. It has specifically been chosen for its legibility across all of our label sizes. You’re welcome to utilise the other name fields and choose from a great range of fonts instead.

Can I resize these labels?

Absolutely! These labels can be easily cut to fit any sized care label. Simply stick your wrap & stick clothing label to the care label & trim the ends just a little so that the two sides still fold over each other & adhere to themselves when you press down. If you cut them too short, they may not have enough vinyl to adhere to on the other side. You can visit our image gallery to see how to resize these labels

Are these okay for kids with sensitive skin?

These wrap & stick clothing labels are made from vinyl. If your child’s skin is sensitive to vinyl, you might like to try our 100% Iron On Clothing Labels.
